meta.source: London Datastore: London Atmospheric Emissions Inventory (LAEI) 2016 (GLA and TFL Air Quality)
meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v2 (GLA and TFL Air Quality). The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.crs_output: EPSG:4326 (WGS84), 6 decimal places; BNG to WGS84 through the OS OSTN15 grid (lib.mjs bngProjector)
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run 2r48w: resources chosen by the written rules (harvest-log.json meta.rules: formats, dedupe, caps); every feature read (GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile, or table rows with coordinate columns as points, the CRS judged per row by value); a feature is kept when it meets the zone (the 3D model box, BNG E 532400-539900, N 176700-182300): a vertex inside, an edge crossing or the box inside a polygon; whole geometries kept, whole_in_zone and in_cw added; WGS84 6 decimals through OSTN15; contact fields dropped.
selection_notes: hand rule: LAEI 2016: grid emission summaries, the road traffic links (GIS), the 20 m concentration grid thinned to 100 m, population and schools exceeding; the per-link emission workbooks (217-447 MB) not read
LAEI_2016_Supporting_Information_RoadTrafficData_GIS.zip: grid thinned to 1 cell in 25 (81958 -> 3980 features)
LAEI_2016_Emissions_Summary_GIS.zip: grid thinned to 1 cell in 25 (40260 -> 9072 features)
